analytics.name: Analytic 1648
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates an app process performing a burst of OS/device attribute lookups (build, hardware, SDK level, system properties) with near-term execution branching (feature gating, module load, permission workflow changes) and/or immediate outbound communications, indicating environment evaluation used to shape follow-on actions.

tuning.description: Correlation window for system-info collection burst → outbound transmission (e.g., 60–900s).
Minimum number of distinct system-attribute reads/queries within window to count as ‘broad fingerprinting’ (tune to telemetry fidelity).
How many distinct attribute categories (build fields, cpu, locale, patch level, network identifiers) must be observed.
If true, require the burst occurs while app is background to reduce noise from legitimate settings/about-device screens.
Legitimate device management, diagnostics, carrier services, and enterprise security apps expected to collect device inventory.
Window for ‘newly contacted domain’ enrichment after fingerprinting burst.
Approximate payload size range used for ‘fingerprint submit’ heuristic (environment dependent).

log_sources.name: android:logcat
log_sources.channel: Application accesses android.os.Build fields or device configuration APIs (MODEL, MANUFACTURER, VERSION.SDK_INT, HARDWARE)

analytics.name: Analytic 1649
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates an app querying device model and iOS version (often limited to UIDevice-visible attributes) with subsequent behavior divergence (capability gating, alternate code paths) and/or near-term outbound connections, suggesting device fingerprinting for decision-making rather than normal telemetry.

tuning.description: Baseline-dependent threshold for distinguishing normal app telemetry from discovery behavior
Defines acceptable delay between device queries and execution changes
Allows tuning for environments with homogeneous vs heterogeneous device fleets

log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Application invokes UIDevice queries (model, systemVersion, name)
